Query recorded samples

Usage:
  smob query [flags]

Flags:
      --data-dir string     override data_dir from the configuration
      --format string       output format: table, json, jsonl, or csv (default "table")
  -h, --help                help for query
      --host string         restrict to one host
      --label stringArray   label matcher: name=value or name~regex (repeatable)
      --limit int           maximum samples; 0 means unlimited (default 10000)
      --metric string       exact metric name
      --scope string        restrict to system, process, or container
      --since string        start time: a duration such as 1h, or an RFC3339 timestamp (default: last hour)
      --until string        end time as an RFC3339 timestamp (default: now)

Global Flags:
      --config string       path to the YAML configuration file (default "/etc/smob/smob.yaml")
      --log-format string   log format override: text, json
      --log-level string    log level override: debug, info, warn, error
